meta.label: MEASURED (2 of 5 crops have a directly-reported baht/rai figure) + DERIVED (baht/rai back-computed from OAE's own baht/ton × kg/rai for the other crops/for cross-check). Nothing fabricated — every number traces to a specific OAE PDF page, and every derived figure is tagged method='derived' with its formula.

url_notes.bb9fb91abe729379.pdf: OAE Zone 1-12 joint study, 'Marginal Abatement Cost of GHG Emission from Main-Season Rice Production' (การศึกษาต้นทุนส่วนเพิ่มการลดก๊าซเรือนกระจก สินค้าพืชเศรษฐกิจ ข้าวนาปี), published 2026-04-27. This is the ONLY OAE document found in this pull that reports total production cost DIRECTLY in baht/rai (Table 4.1-4.3, abstract). 37-province farmer survey (267 farmers x 2 groups = 534), crop year 2567/68 (2024/25).
url_notes.Cai-up-2568.pdf: OAE Center for Agricultural Information (CAI) annual commodity-economics compendium 'Cai-up 2568' (สารสนเทศเศรษฐกิจการเกษตรรายสินค้า). Already committed at source-data/oae_farm_economics.json via pipeline/pull_oae_farm_economics.py; re-read here (raw copied to source-data/raw/oae-costs/caiup-2568.pdf) specifically for its baht/TON cost row (row 5 or 6 'ต้นทุนการผลิต (บาท/ตัน)') on the rice/maize/cassava/rubber/oilpalm commodity pages, 3-year column series 2566/2567/2568 — 2568 (rightmost) taken as the current-year figure. NOTE: the committed oae_farm_economics.json left cassava.cost_per_ton and oilpalm.cost_per_ton as null because the extraction script assumed a 4-token row for that field; the raw row for those two crops only has 3 tokens (a genuine schema difference from rice/rubber/maize, confirmed by reading the page text directly) — the values (2,130 and 3,010 THB/ton) exist on the page and are captured here. This is a known small bug in pull_oae_farm_economics.py worth fixing upstream.
url_notes.catalog.oae.go.th searches: CKAN catalog.oae.go.th was enumerated in full (57 packages, package_search q=*:* rows=1000, cached as source-data/raw/oae-costs/all_packages.json) and searched for ต้นทุน (cost) and ต้นทุนการผลิต (production cost). NO dedicated machine-readable 'production cost per rai' dataset exists in the catalog — only 3 logistics-cost datasets (transport/storage/loss cost per crop, a different concept) and dataoae3103 (the Cai-up compendium PDF, hand-parsed above). This mirrors the farmgate_prices.json finding that OAE's farm-gate PRICE series is also not machine-readable on this catalog — cost-of-production is the same story.

crop_years.rice_ghg_study: 2567/68 (2024/25 cropping season) — main-season rice only (ข้าวนาปี)
crop_years.cai_up_compendium: 2568 (latest column of a 2566-2567-2568 series; rice/maize page figures are 'crop year 2568/69, OAE forecast as of Mar 2569' per the already-committed oae_farm_economics.json meta)

parse_notes: rice has TWO independent measurements that roughly cross-check: the GHG-study survey (4,644.06 THB/rai, conventional-fertilizer farmer group, DIRECTLY reported) vs. the Cai-up compendium's cost-per-ton x yield-per-rai (4,196.72 THB/rai, DERIVED). They differ ~10%, plausible given different vintages (2567/68 actual survey vs 2568 OAE forecast) and different farmer samples (37-province survey vs national compendium average) — both are kept, neither overwrites the other.

cassava and oilpalm cost_per_ton were NOT extracted by the already-committed pull_oae_farm_economics.py (field left null) due to a column-count assumption bug; the true values (cassava 2,130 THB/ton, oilpalm 3,010 THB/ton, both crop-year 2568) were read directly off the cached PDF page text in this pull and are included here, each tagged method='derived_from_cost_per_ton' for the resulting baht/rai figure.

maize and rubber cost_per_ton WERE already correctly extracted in the committed oae_farm_economics.json (6,760 and 63,180 THB/ton respectively); baht/rai here is DERIVED from those figures x each crop's OAE-measured yield_kg_per_rai.

cash vs non-cash cost split: NOT FOUND in either source within this pull. The GHG-study PDF's detailed Table 4.1 (per printed page 51 of the report body, not the same as PDF physical page 51) likely itemises cost components (labor/fertilizer/land rent/machinery) but was not reached within this pull's time budget — logged as a gap, not fabricated.

sugarcane: NO OAE production-cost-per-rai figure found. Not covered by the Cai-up compendium (only rice/maize/cassava/rubber/oilpalm) and no dedicated OAE or OCSB (สำนักงานคณะกรรมการอ้อยและน้ำตาล) machine-readable source turned up in this search pass. OMITTED, not fabricated.

durian/longan: NO OAE production-cost-per-rai figure found; the compendium covers only the 5 major field crops, and OAE's tropical-fruit CKAN dataset ('tropical-fruits') is a VALUE-of-production series, not a cost series. OMITTED.

regional breakdown: NONE of the figures captured here are regional — all are NATIONAL averages (rice GHG study = 37-province survey average; Cai-up = national compendium figure). The task's 'regional where offered' condition was not met for any crop in this pull.
